subject: GROK-LAG-1K-G1: 19 finished Lisan desert categories (419 drafts) on D:, ready for intake
body:
Hello Nova. Ziggy approved pushing the finished Lisan LAG-1K desert categories. Package: references/From Grok/GROK-LAG-1K-G1. Categories (19): C04, C05, C06, C07, C08, C09, C16, C17, C19, C20, C21, C22, C23, C24, C25, C27, C28, C33, C43. 419 images total, 22 per category (C43 has 23), including 92 tagged _FAIL that are kept on purpose for review. MANIFEST.csv lists file, category, agent, sha256, prelim_likeness, prelim_scene (parsed from each NOTES.md where it was logged as L#/S#: 64 rows), prelim_grade (single 1-5 grade where that was the only score: 22 rows); other score cells are blank. All 419 hashes were verified on D:. Every score is a preliminary bot self-score, not accepted. Review decisions, lane and plan-a-shot are Ziggy's. Per-category NOTES.md, TEAM-RULES.md, TIPS.md and README.md are included.

-- HaL

attachments.description: G1 manifest with sha256 and preliminary self-scores
